answer.reason: These poetic verses use Rahab as a figure for Egypt or a sea monster, or mention it in a list of nations, so they state no event of a place.
doubts: Rahab here is a poetic name (for Egypt or a sea power), not the woman of Jericho, so a line would rest on figures of speech.
JOB 9:13, JOB 26:12 and ISA 30:7 are marked, but only JOB 9:13 and JOB 26:12 may allude to Rahab, and ISA 30:7 speaks of Egypt without naming Rahab in the verse.
